description: Tuesday 10:30: Tom Henderson rewrites the contact-block line of his SunCoast office bulletin page in Notion: from today every SunCoast listing ad, post, newsletter piece and open-house handout gives the office line (813) 555-0100 right after the brokerage name. At Monday's start the line deferred to each agent's launch standards. The page's edit time moves. Tuesday 10:45: Tom emails Brittany that before the listing's first open house he will walk the house with her, so it has to be empty from noon that day (Brittany's standards alone would clear it by 1 PM for a 2 PM start). The mail lands unread. Nothing announces either.

row.body:
Hi Brittany,

Sea Grape looks good for coming soon tomorrow. Before its first open house I'd like to walk the house with you, the way I do with every new listing, so please have it empty from noon that day.

Tom
